fix_summary.problem: Missing rename method in TodoApp class despite Todo.rename() existing
fix_summary.solution: Added TodoApp.rename(todo_id: int, text: str) -> Todo method that follows the same pattern as mark_done/mark_undone

acceptance_criteria.criterion: TodoApp.rename(todo_id: int, text: str) -> Todo method exists
Method raises ValueError for non-existent ID
Method validates text is not empty via Todo.rename()
Method saves updated todos to storage

test_plan.step: Create TodoApp, add todo, call rename(), verify text updated
Call rename() with non-existent ID, verify ValueError
Call rename() with empty text, verify ValueError

risks_and_limitations: No CLI command exposed for rename - only the TodoApp method was added as per the issue requirements
